// Craft CMS passkey replay (GHSA-wg23-69c2-gjc8): >1 successful POST to users/login-with-passkey from one client in a short window
let Window = 10m;
W3CIISLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where csMethod == "POST"
| where csUriStem contains "login-with-passkey" or csUriQuery contains "login-with-passkey"
| where scStatus in (200, 302)          // Craft returns 200 (AJAX) / 302 on a completed passkey login
| summarize Attempts = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Statuses = make_set(scStatus), UserAgents = make_set(csUserAgent), Hosts = make_set(Computer) by cIP, csUriStem, bin(TimeGenerated, Window)
| where Attempts >= 2                    // 2 = a real ceremony is a single successful POST; repeats = replayed assertion body
| extend WindowSeconds = datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| order by Attempts desc
